title: Standing in the Fire and Praising Your Way to Breakthrough
description: "Join us as we hear a powerful testimony of faith and perseverance in the face of spiritual attack. This week's sermon is a gripping account of one woman's battle with the enemy, where she refused to give up, even when her body was weakened and she was on the verge of collapse. You'll be inspired and challenged to stand firm in your faith, no matter what obstacles you may be facing."
